newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela 1996 imports off 15.6 pct at $9.1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela 1996 imports off 15.6 pct at $9.1 bln.

text.p: The value of Venezuelan imports dropped 15.6 percent to $9.12 billion in 1996, compared to $10.79 million in 1995, according to provisional figures released by the Central Office of Statistics and Information (OCEI).
The U.S. was the top exporter to Venezuela with 43.7 percent, followed by Colombia with 7.6 percent, Germany with 4.4 percent, Brazil with 4.3 percent and Italy with 3.7 percent.

Economic recession saw imports fall across all sectors, the OCEI said, except for market vegetables which grew 7.8 percent to $945 million. Electrical goods remained the highest category at $2.43 billion.
